title: mod_nats wire catalog
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 methods and events for mod_nats protocol 2.5.0. Canonical names are fs.*; XNode.* aliases are accepted when compat-xcc is on. Requests go to {prefix}node.{node_uuid}. Owner and observer events go to {prefix}ctrl.{ctrl_uuid}.

ctrl_uuid.description: Controller id. On an owned channel this must be the Accept owner; observers are rejected with result.code 419.

id.description: Absent id means a notification: the method runs and no reply is sent.

params.description: Method arguments. Every method accepts an optional idempotency_key (1-128 chars) scoped by (params.uuid, ctrl_uuid): a repeat whose previous execution finished 200/202 replays the stored result with idempotent_replay=true instead of executing again. Failures are never cached.

code.description: 200 OK, 202 accepted, 400 refused, 404 no channel, 419 owned by someone else, 480 dial failed, 500 internal, 501 unknown method, 503 queue full.

idempotent_replay.description: True when the result was replayed from the idempotency cache instead of executing again.

channel_params.description: Extra channel variables copied onto later Event.Channel messages for this uuid.

fs.channel.observe.description: Subscribe this ctrl_uuid to the channel mailbox. Does not take ownership. Idempotent. Cap is 32 observers per channel.

fs.channel.touch.description: Renew the ownership lease without any other action. Every successful owner request renews implicitly; touch exists for controllers that only listen between calls. Result carries lease_ttl when a lease is armed (owner-lease-ttl > 0).

cause.description: FreeSWITCH hangup cause name. Default NORMAL_CLEARING.

fs.channel.record.description: Start/stop a session recording (mirrors uuid_record). The file path is the recording key: STOP/PAUSE/MASK must repeat the same path. Paths containing '..' are rejected.

fs.channel.detectspeech.description: Background speech detection via the FS core ASR API. The engine is whichever loaded module implements switch_asr_interface (test, pocketsphinx, unimrcp:profile, ...); audio never touches the bus - results arrive as Event.Detected with type=asr.

engine.description: ASR module name, required for START (unknown engines are refused with 400 asr engine unavailable).

grammar.description: Grammar text, URI or local file name, required for START.

params.description: Engine parameters applied via switch_ivr_set_param_detect_speech before the grammar loads.

fs.channel.transfer.description: Move the channel to a dialplan extension (switch_ivr_session_transfer). If the channel is bridged, this is a blind transfer: the bridge is left and the peer's fate follows its own hangup_after_bridge/park_after_bridge settings.

fs.channel.hold.description: Hold or unhold the channel (switch_ivr_hold_uuid / switch_ivr_unhold_uuid). Unhold is refused by the core while the callstate is not HELD.

fs.channel.mute.description: Mute or unmute media (switch_ivr_session_audio; unmute stops the audio bug entirely).

mute.description: Default true. false stops the audio bug.

fs.channel.threeway.description: Bring b_uuid into the call: the current partner is held silently (no MOH broadcast into its session) and remembered on the binding; UnBridge2 later splits and unholds it. Both legs must be owned by this ctrl.

fs.channel.unbridge2.description: Split the call: both legs are pre-armed with park_after_bridge and transferred to dest so neither is torn down by the unbridge race. A peer set aside by threeway is unheld. dest is required - typically an answer+park extension.

peer_uuid.description: If the peer is owned, ctrl_uuid must own that leg too.

data.description: Array of variable names, or an object whose keys are the names. Omitted returns a small built-in set.

fs.node.hello.description: Returns proto_version, subject_prefix, compat_xcc and the capability name list.

fs.node.status.description: sessions, sessions_peak, sessions_max, sps, sps_peak, uptime, version. Linux builds also add cpu and memory fields.

fs.channel.dial.description: Request thread enqueues and returns 202 plus job_uuid. Event.Result on the ctrl mailbox carries the same job_uuid and the original rpc id.

global_params.description: Copied onto the originate variable event as-is.

Event.Metrics.description: Same object as fs.node.status, wrapped as a notification on {prefix}metrics.

Event.NodeUp.description: Same object as the fs.node.hello result data field. Published on {prefix}event.nodeup at load.

Event.OwnerLost.description: The owner lease elapsed and the channel is unclaimed again; a standby controller can re-Accept. Published on the old owner's mailbox and on {prefix}event.ownerlost.

Event.Detected.description: Detected input on a channel. DTMF digits (type=dtmf, one per keypress) and ASR results (type=asr, from switch_ivr_detect_speech engines) arrive here on the owner/observer mailboxes and, per event-routing, {prefix}event.detected. The event-driven replacement for blocking XNode.ReadDTMF/DetectSpeech calls.

duration.description: type=dtmf: digit duration in ms, when the platform reported it.

speech.description: type=asr: the engine result when the body was JSON (e.g. {text, confidence, grammar}).

text.description: type=asr: the engine result verbatim when the body was not JSON.

request_id.description: Echo of the X-Request-Id header, when the dial carried one.

id.description: Present on Event.Result when the dial request had an id.
